heroSubtitle: The Gloucester Zakat Fund is your trusted local charity for collecting and distributing Zakat to those in need within our community.

steps.title: Calculate Your Zakat
steps.description: Use our easy-to-use calculator to determine the amount of Zakat you need to pay.

steps.title: Give Securely Online
steps.description: Make your Zakat payment through our secure online portal with confidence.

steps.title: Impact Your Community
steps.description: We ensure your Zakat is distributed effectively to eligible recipients in Gloucester.

impactText: Every penny of your Zakat is a lifeline for someone in our community. We support families facing hardship, individuals seeking education, and those in critical need of assistance. Your contribution fosters a stronger, more resilient Gloucester for everyone.
testimonialsIntro: These words were written to GZF by the people your zakat reached. They are shared anonymously.

testimonials.quote: Before the support, I was in a dark and depressing place, facing very unpredictable circumstances. With the support of GZF and the community, I can finally see some light in my life. From my heart, thank you so much.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

testimonials.quote: I was so scared to ask for help and to be open about my circumstances. I was embarrassed. After seeing my family suffer because of fear or ego, I reached out. Now, with GZF and the community's support, I have started work.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

testimonials.quote: I honestly cannot express how grateful I am. Your support has lifted such a huge burden off my shoulders. I finally have some peace of mind, Alhamdulillah.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

testimonials.quote: I sincerely feel you have done more than enough for me, and I would be very happy for GZF to use its resources to support other brothers and sisters who may be in greater need.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

testimonials.quote: Your support has been a real help to me during this difficult time. I am truly grateful.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

testimonials.quote: As a family, we will always keep you all in our prayers. May Allah grant you all happiness, health and Jannah.
testimonials.author: GZF recipient, 2025–26

ctaText: Join us in strengthening our community. Your contribution, big or small, makes a world of difference.
